free_tier.stated: Trial Access Projects on Fugaku award up to 100,000 node-hours per project, free of charge, with the call open throughout the year, a project period of up to half a year, and screening results notified within one to two weeks; a First-touch option fixes 1,000 node-hours per project for a simplified application.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: The 1,000 NH first-touch tier needs only an online form and eligibility check, so it is the cheapest way to obtain a Fugaku scaling number that a later full proposal can cite.

limits.value: The project representative must obtain approval from the head of their organisation and must belong to a legal entity, so an individual with no organisation cannot lead the project even though the call is free and open all year.

evidence.proved: Available Resources per project 'Up to 100,000 Node-Hours'; First-touch option '1,000 Node-Hours per project (fixed)'; usage fee 'None'; project period up to half a year; call opens throughout the year, quoted
'Awarding result will be notified as soon as the screening process is completed. (Estimated to be within one or two weeks after a proposal is received.)', quoted

Trial Access screening method is 'Online application content confirmation and eligibility screening' for first-touch and 'Review of the application form and eligibility screening' for the 100,000 NH tier, against 'Expert screening' for General Access, quoted

Proposal instructions section 2: the general-category project representative is 'a person belonging to a legal entity (university, research institute, incorporated association, company, etc.) regardless of whether inside or outside Japan', except that company employees must belong to a company registered in Japan, quoted in Japanese

FAQ: use by non-residents of Japan and by non-Japanese nationals 'is possible'; a non-resident may be project representative; for Fugaku, projects with non-resident participants need separate R-CCS approval, quoted in Japanese

notes: The strongest single number: 100,000 Fugaku node-hours free, open all year, no competitive expert review at the trial tier. Fugaku nodes carry one A64FX CPU with 48 compute cores plus 4 assistant cores, so 100,000 node-hours is roughly 4.8 million core-hours; that conversion is arithmetic from the published node design, not a quoted figure. The binding door is the organisational signature, not money and not the science case. Foreign non-resident participants are explicitly allowed but require separate R-CCS approval under the Foreign Exchange and Foreign Trade Act.
